decision.observation: Hornet is airborne at about (0.51, 0.40) after a Left+Z jump, drifting left in the light-shaft chamber. The raised mossy terrace is below at about (0.25-0.46, 0.62), and a higher stone ledge is further left at about (0.0-0.2, 0.42). Green light shafts fall in the center.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing Left should land her on the raised terrace. From there, another Left+Z jump can reach the higher left ledge and upper areas.
decision.memory: In the light-shaft chamber west of the cage. The cage is not standable. East pocket is a dead end. Bell chamber cleared. West vine column not breakable. No living enemies found; silk empty; 20 shards. Testing the raised terrace and upper-left ledge route.
